ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of $4.17 to the rider (NS-7) for the unexcused detour, and note the RD-1 breach on the driver's record for the 2.96 km off-route segment.

segment_findings.reason: No RD-5 consent: the in-app chat is empty, so no rider message before 09:32 agrees to a route the driver named, and the driver's post-trip statement of a GPS reroute is not consent [F7][F8][RD-5]. No RD-4 excuse: no incident on the replaced stretch and only band 4 speed records [F11][F9][F10][RD-4]. No RD-3 stop was named or measured [F7][RD-3(a)]. The 2.96 km extra is therefore refundable [F3][RD-2].

what_would_change: F3: if the judge finds the rider agreed to this route or named this stop beforehand, it is exempt; if not, $4.17 is refunded; if the record cannot settle it, a person decides.
Had the driver carried a prior upheld route dispute in the last 90 days, RD-6 would add an account flag.
